name: M5.OrderCount.divisor_subset_domain
statement: ∀ (N d k : ℕ), (M5.OrderCount.divisorPositions N d).powersetCard k = ((M5.OrderCount.positivePositions N).powersetCard k).filter (fun U => ∀ s ∈ U, d ∣ s)
guidance: Use Finset.mem_powersetCard and membership of filter to show equivalence of subsets of positivePositions restricted by divisibility; ext U and simp. No positivity premise on d is necessary. Return tactic lines only without leading by. Keep the target unchanged.
